title: Add shadow detector observation request contract and validator
user_business_goal: Give MLOps/engineering a contract and CLI validator for the metadata-only payload accepted by POST /detector/shadow/observations, so model output can be prepared and checked before connecting real training/runtime artifacts.
out_of_scope: raw images, videos, raw datasets, customer/factory data, notebooks, model weights, TensorRT engines, model binaries, or model execution
live camera capture, camera SDK loading, camera credentials, GPU/hardware validation, or hardware readiness approval
request-supplied filesystem paths, model manifests, model refs as authority, dataset paths, or artifact directories
backend decision semantics, HMI visual redesign, or QC tablet layout changes
production deploy/release, secrets, tokens, provider credentials, destructive migrations, production data migration, billing, legal/compliance behavior, or security boundary change
product spec approval, QC/SOP tolerance approval, model promotion approval, production PASS/NG authority, or production auto-reject behavior
acceptance_criteria: Add a JSON schema for shadow_detector_observation_request.v1 describing the request payload for /detector/shadow/observations.
Add a validator function/CLI that accepts a JSON payload file and returns JSON validation result.
Valid payloads include detector request metadata plus sanitized observations with label, confidence, and normalized bbox only.

Validator rejects raw-media source URIs, request-supplied artifact/model/dataset paths, observation model_ref, observation evidence_ref, malformed bbox/confidence, missing request fields, extra fields, and missing input files.
Add a safe sample payload fixture that validates against the schema and endpoint contract.
Existing detector dry-run endpoint, detector status, replay/HMI observation flow, artifact readiness, feedback, and product CI behavior remains valid.

memory_preflight.query: Flange QC v2 shadow detector observation request contract, MLOps metadata payload validator, no model execution.
retrieved_decisions: App integrates sanitized observation metadata through contracts.
Manifest detector endpoint is review-only and production authority remains false.
retrieved_lessons: MLOps-facing artifacts need schema and CLI validation before runtime integration.
Request payloads cannot provide filesystem paths, model refs, evidence refs, raw media, or authority.
memory_preflight.conflicts_found: runtime/Windmill daily attention is understood as non-app-code auth/session blocker; this task does not require Windmill secret access.

rollback_note: Revert the FQV2-043 PR to remove the shadow detector observation request schema, validator CLI, sample payload, tests, docs, and gate evidence. Existing detector dry-run endpoint, detector status endpoint, replay/HMI observation flow, artifact readiness, feedback, and product CI behavior remain valid.
